Pluss · Space

PlussQit

The core object layer of Pluss: Series for numeric and boolean values, Note for vectorized text, Timeline for instants, and Duration for elapsed time.

API Reference

What's in this space

PlussQit owns the four foundational objects every table and time-series operation in the rest of Pluss is built from.

Series Numeric · Boolean

The tensor-style numeric and boolean object underneath every numeric Slate column.

Note Text

The vectorized text object underneath every string-like Slate column.

Timeline Instants

The temporal object for absolute instants, calendar projections, timezone work, and ordered-axis access through index().

Duration Elapsed Time

The temporal object for signed elapsed quantities, fixed-width offsets, and differences between instants.
